name: Grey Edge
description: Automatic white balance that estimates the light color from the edges of the picture (grey edge assumption).

inputs.name: src
inputs.description: Picture to correct, at least 3 pixels wide

params.name: difford
params.description: Order of the Gaussian derivative: 0 uses the smoothed picture (grey world, or max-RGB with minknorm 0), 1 the gradient, 2 the second derivatives

params.name: minknorm
params.description: Minkowski norm of the estimate: 0 takes the maximum (max-RGB), 1 the mean, higher values lean towards the maximum

params.name: sigma
params.description: Standard deviation of the Gaussian, in pixels; must be at least 1/6 when difford is above 0, else the picture is left as it is
